subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers always be denied access to legacy ownerless session rows, or must upgrades provide an explicit ownership migration or adoption path?
rationale: Failing closed is the safer isolation rule, but it intentionally changes access to persisted pre-ownership rows and repository history does not establish the desired upgrade contract.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject ownerless rows for plugin-runtime callers and document and prove that operators or non-plugin clients remain the recovery path.

options.title: Add migration path
options.body: Provide a narrow doctor or operator workflow that assigns ownership before plugin-runtime mutation is permitted.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows for plugin-runtime callers and document and prove that operators or non-plugin clients remain the recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent ownership of the SQLite session lifecycle boundary where the compatibility and authority contract is enforced.
